hypotheses.title: Dual-Alpha Dynamic Synergy: Customer Return Inversion & Short-Term Delta
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Dynamically branches between the 10-day linearly decayed customer return reversal signal and 3-day short-term price mean-reversion. Exploits supply chain information friction when customer signals are pronounced, and fills neutral periods with high-conviction subindustry mean-reversion to maximize Sharpe and Fitness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if branching reduces Sharpe below 1.0 or increases turnover beyond 25%.

candidates.rationale: Dual dynamic branching of customer momentum inversion and 3-day close delta

hypotheses.title: Short-Dated Option Volatility Risk Premium (10d Call IV / 20d Historical Vol)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits short-term Volatility Risk Premium (VRP) by comparing 10-day call implied volatility against 20-day historical realized close-to-close volatility within GICS subindustries. High call IV relative to realized volatility captures institutional upside hedging demand and volatility risk premia.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if short-term IV is structurally depressed below realized volatility across subindustries.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-relative short-dated call IV over 20-day realized volatility with 20-day backfill
